verdict.rationale: OpenTofu keeps your infrastructure as plain, versionable configuration code that also works with Terraform, so leaving is mostly a matter of keeping your files. It is a drop-in Terraform replacement under Linux Foundation open-source governance, and community users describe migration as a simple find-and-replace. However, the evidence never documents the state file format or any explicit export or portability path. Missing for 10: documentation that state/plan files use an open, readable format; an explicit data export or offboarding guide; independent hands-on evidence of migrating away from OpenTofu (as opposed to toward it).
